ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area exceeding 95% of visible fluke pixels, with high-intensity (white) localized only to the trailing edge margins and surface abrasions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous solid black field across both lobes. High-contrast white contiguous banding is mapped along the inner boundary of the trailing edge serrations. Distinct high-intensity white focal points are localized at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an approximate 55-degree pixel angle and significant vertical depth relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern with distinct peaks and valleys. Approximately 14 primary peaks on the left lobe and 12 on the right lobe, featuring localized white pixel saturation at the crests.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the upper trailing edge transitioning to a convex curve on the lower lobe body, ending in sharp, tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of small, circular white pixel clusters localized at the far lateral margins of both lobes, consistent with localized surface colonization marks.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent, high-contrast diagonal linear mark on the mid-left lobe; one shorter, narrower linear mark on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable deep irregular indentation/notch on the outer margin of the right trailing edge, distinct from the standard serration frequency. Visible white linear scarring on the central-left lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The trailing edge peaks are highlighted by a consistent thin margin of white pixels, creating a high-contrast 'fringed' boundary against the water background.
